title: card.transport Response Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Response containing the current connectivity method configuration of the Notecard.

allow.description: When `true`, the Notecard is configured to allow adding Notes to non-compact Notefiles while connected over a non-terrestrial network. See [Define NTN vs non-NTN Templates](https://dev.blues.io/starnote/satellite-best-practices/#define-ntn-vs-non-ntn-templates).

method.description: The connectivity method currently enabled on the device.

sub-descriptions.description: The transport mode is set to the device default.
Cellular only is enabled on the device.
Prioritizes cellular connectivity while falling back to NTN if a cellular connection cannot be established.
NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network) mode is enabled on the device for use with Starnote.
WiFi only is enabled on the device.
Prioritizes WiFi connectivity while falling back to cellular if a WiFi connection cannot be established. This is the default behavior on Notecard Cell+WiFi.
Prioritizes WiFi connectivity while falling back to cellular, and lastly to NTN.
Prioritizes WiFi connectivity while falling back to NTN if a WiFi connection cannot be established.

seconds.description: The amount of time (in seconds) the Notecard will spend on any fallback transport before retrying the first transport specified in the `method`. The default is `3600` (60 minutes).

umin.description: When `true`, the Notecard is configured to force a longer network transport timeout when using Wideband Notecards.

samples.title: WiFi-Cell Priority Response
samples.description: Response showing WiFi-cellular priority transport mode is active.

samples.description: Response showing cellular-only transport mode is active.
